zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bla ma brgyud rim gyi bskang ba 'brel tshad rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad

tei:div.tei:p: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bla ma brgyud rim gyi bskang ba 'brel tshad rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngo bo ka dag chos sku'i pho brang nas// chos sku kun bzang lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku'i gzhal yas nas// rdor 'chang longs sku'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// thugs rje phyogs med sprul sku'i pho brang nas// rdor sems sprul sku'i lha tshogs= mkha' spyod bde ldan gnas mchog chen po nas// gu ru dga' rab rdo rje'i= lhun grub chos dbyings gnas mchog dam pa nas// rig 'dzin shrī sengha'i= zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog dam pa nas// slob dpon pad+ma'i lha tshogs= o rgyan 'dus pa'i gnas mchog chen po nas// mtsho rgyal ḍā ki'i lha tshogs= sgam po dpal ri'i gnas mchog chen po nas// chos rgyal karma gling pa'i= gar bzhugs bde chen chos kyi pho brang nas// thugs sras nyi zla chos rje'i= 'gro 'dul thabs mkhas thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// sras mchog nyi zla 'od zer= sgrub gnas rin chen gling gi pho brang nas// nam mkha' chos kyi rgyal mtshan= smin grol bde la bkod pa'i pho brang nas// mkhas grub lha dbang mtshan can= bskyed rdzogs brtan pa thob pa'i pho brang nas// ting 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i= zag med bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas nas// sprul sku karma gu ru'i= phyogs med 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho brang nas// gar dbang pad+ma rgyal mtshan= gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad pa'i gzhal yas nas// mtshan ldan pad+ma ma ti'i= rim gnyis rtsal rdzogs byin rlabs pho brang nas// sprul sku thugs rje'i 'od zer= snang srid sgyu ma rang grol gzhal yas nas// 'khrul zhig bud+dha maṅga'i= zab gsang smin grol mchog gi pho brang nas// rig 'dzin kun dga' grags pa'i= phyogs med 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i pho brang nas// gar dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin=

bde chen dga' bzhi dbang rdzogs gzhal yas nas// rig 'dzin sbas pa'i rnal 'byor= bsam yas yon tan kun rdzogs pho brang nas// mkhas grub karma chags med= gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad pa'i pho brang nas// rig 'dzin a nan+ta yi= mdo sngags zab gsang rnam rol gzhal yas nas// 'gran bral sprul sku mchog gi= bskyed rdzogs yon tan mthar phyin pho brang nas// mkhas mchog bud+dha'i mtshan can= spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng nas// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i= rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs= bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i= pad+mas bka' bsgos gter gyi gnyer gtad pa'i// gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi= thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang*// za le 'bri dang shel sgong lug /tsa ra mkha' lding mdangs kyis bskang*// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*// rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang*// rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang*// sha chen lang ling sna tshogs dang*// snang gsal zhun gyi mar me dang*// sha chen gsur gyi dud pa dang*// thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra dang*// rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang*// thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// bka' srung dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// khyed kyi thugs dam bskang gyur cig /khyed kyi thugs dam bskang nas kyang*// bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig /g.yar dam skong la rkyen dbang zlog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// ces bla ma brgyud rim gyi bskang ba rdzogs so//
